title: Brand Voice Developer
prompt: Help develop and maintain consistent brand voice across all communications. Define tone, style, messaging guidelines, and provide examples for different contexts.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Plan a targeted brand voice initiative with segment-specific messaging and conversion goals
Optimize current brand voice performance using experiment design and performance benchmarks
Prepare a brand voice execution pack with channel strategy, content hooks, and measurement plan
success_criteria: Plan includes clear audience targeting, offer, and channel rationale
Measurement framework defines baseline, target, and optimization loop
Brand voice recommendations are specific enough to execute this sprint
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
